ra: Olodumare is the supreme being at the head of the Yoruba orisha cosmos (Bascom).
Eshu/Eleggua is a principal orisha (Brandon).
Obatala is a senior orisha (Brandon).
Ogun is a principal orisha (Bascom).
Shango is a principal orisha (Brandon).
Oshun is a principal orisha (Brandon).
Yemoja is a principal orisha (Brandon).
Oya is a principal orisha (Brandon).
Babalu-Aye is a principal orisha (Brandon).
Orunmila is the orisha of Ifa wisdom (Bascom).
Olokun is an orisha of the deep sea (Brandon).
The Ibeji twins are venerated among the orisha (Bascom).
Aganju is counted among the orisha (Brandon).
Eleggua is one of the Siete Potencias Africanas in Cuban devotion (Brandon).
Ogun is one of the Seven African Powers (Brandon).
Shango is one of the Seven African Powers (Brandon).
Obatala is one of the Seven African Powers (Brandon).
Oshun is one of the Seven African Powers (Brandon).
Yemaya is one of the Seven African Powers (Brandon).
Orula is commonly counted among the Seven African Powers in Cuban devotion (Brandon).
Eshu carries the offerings and messages between humans and all the orishas, opening the way; he is the mediator, not the ruler, of the pantheon (Bascom).
In Yoruba oral tradition Oshun is a wife of Shango (Brandon).
In Yoruba oral tradition Oya is a wife of Shango (Brandon).
Aganju is linked to Shango as kin in some oral traditions (Brandon).
Olokun (deep sea) is paired with Yemoja (sea/motherhood) in oral tradition (Brandon).
In Cuban Lucumi/Santeria Shango is identified with Saint Barbara, sharing thunder/lightning imagery (Brandon).
In Santeria Eleggua is commonly identified with Saint Anthony of Padua (and the Holy Child of Atocha, not in DB) (Brandon).
In Santeria Babalu-Aye is identified with Saint Lazarus (San Lazaro), patron against disease; ENT_NT_LAZARUS_BETHANY is the in-DB Lazarus target (Brandon).
In Santeria Obatala is identified with Our Lady of Mercy (la Merced), sharing the color white (Brandon).
In Santeria Ogun is identified with Saint Peter, linked by iron keys/tools (Brandon).
In Santeria Orunmila/Orula is identified with Saint Francis of Assisi (Brandon).
In Cuban Santeria Yemaya is identified with the Marian title Our Lady of Regla (a title not in DB); wired to Mary Theotokos as the underlying Marian devotion (Brandon).
In Cuban Santeria Oshun is identified with Our Lady of Charity of El Cobre, Cuba's patroness (a title not in DB, verified absent); wired to Mary Theotokos as the underlying Marian devotion (Brandon).
